Interpret.input: a payload admitted by semantic-convergence.schema.json and its profile-specific typing rules
Interpret.result: Profile-indexed interpreted declaration. ModelContract returns the existing Rule-declaration role; other profiles use resultRoles. Never a bare Boolean authorization or product completion.
Interpret.effects: none for interpretation; external methods require separate admitted execution

resultRoles.finite-observation: model declaration with typed named formulas, not product satisfaction
resultRoles.observation-game: strategy problem with observation and quantifier scope
resultRoles.stable-ground: logic program plus nonmonotonic query domain
resultRoles.acyclic-scm: causal model, not an identification conclusion
resultRoles.explicit-system-f: typed declaration bundle after profile typing
resultRoles.predicative-dependent: typed declaration bundle with explicit assumptions
resultRoles.deep-handlers: control/effect declaration bundle after capture checks
resultRoles.norm-transition: policy/event model with separate obligation occurrences
resultRoles.semantic-presentation: typed theory or model class, never assumed consistent
resultRoles.model-contract: existing Requirement Rule declaration with exactly one formal on:subjectTypeRef, not a Boolean judgment

model-contract.input: ModelContract payload; linked subject type and exact finite-observation specifications/claim selectors
model-contract.resultRole: existing Requirement Rule declaration; one formal on:subjectTypeRef; independent obligations retained per source occurrence
model-contract.effects: pure linking only; no external evaluation

requiredResolvedDependencies: total state valuation and admissible relation
finite-observation.resultRole: model declaration; interpretation does not execute model checking

requiredResolvedDependencies: information mode and exact finite transition horizon
actual observation realization for deployment claims
observation-game.resultRole: strategy problem; full-information truth does not grant hidden observation

requiredResolvedDependencies: profile-specific types and pure term grammar
typed-program.resultRole: typed declarations after the stated checks, not a normalization proof for arbitrary host recursion

requiredResolvedDependencies: same intended subject and observation maps
cross-profile.resultRole: original Claim/Requirement relation with exact residuals; no new public consumer

InterpretTrait.input: A payload admitted by trait-body.schema.json in the exact complete candidate Type/Expr/TypeParam graph, with resolved dialect binding and lexical declarations.
InterpretTrait.result: An existing typed trait declaration or implementation witness with associated projections, method signatures/bodies and qualified obligations. Never runtime authority or program equivalence.
InterpretTrait.owner: ../../../docs/领域/计算基础/作者表示与实现分工.md#structured-trait-profile
InterpretTrait.effects: pure interpretation and checking; method effects remain their declared bounds and require separately admitted execution
requiredResolvedDependencies: exact candidate Schema closure and trait body interpretation
self, trait and method binders with shared kind and substitution rules
real referenced declarations, supertraits and trait bounds
qualified coherence scope, associated-type equalities and method bodies
selected witness and target/open-export constraints when demanded
